text:
Maya (CS): FYI - account Polaris spiked last night during onboarding tests. We need quick QBR figures and a P0 triage.

Eli (CSE): Seeing repeated gen calls with identical request_id every 10s. Looks like a client retry loop. `grep 'request_id=px-11' /logs/polaris/infer.log | wc -l` -> 1800 (expected ~30).

Ruth (Finance): If sustained, this could add ~$12k extra this month. Can someone produce a 14-day extrapolated run-rate and a conservative QBR line item for potential credits?

Omar (Solutions): I'll check with the customer to pause their batch job. Maya - do we have an enablement touch scheduled?

Maya (CS): Quick touch tomorrow. I'll ask them to halt ingestion. Also capture their feedback: default SDK retry seems opaque.

Eli (CSE): Immediate steps: apply per-account temporary cap, enable payload dedupe, and mark logs for postmortem. OpsBot, can you set a cap?

OpsBot: /run set-quota --account polaris --daily-tokens 3000000 --reason "onboarding noise triage"

OpsBot: Result: quota updated.

Ruth (Finance): Please export hourly tokens for last 48h as CSV (ts,tokens,requests,model) and drop link. I'll prepare three QBR scenarios (base, corrected, worst-case) by EOD.

Eli (CSE): Exporting now: `rw billing export --account polaris --hours 48 --format csv --fields ts,tokens,requests,model > /shared/polaris_48h.csv`

Omar (Solutions): Customer confirms an automated retryer was pointed at prod during ramp. They will rollout fix. Asking about a one-time onboarding credit.

Maya (CS): Add QBR ask: "one-off onboarding credit + joint ramp checklist". Capture customer quote for deck.

Eli (CSE): I'll open ticket 6012 with logs and suggested SDK backoff doc update.

Ruth (Finance): Got CSV link. I'll model scenarios and propose a credit size if numbers justify it.

Maya (CS): Action items: Eli - root cause & postmortem, Omar - confirm customer rollback and quote, Ruth - scenario slides, Maya - update QBR doc.

Eli (CSE): Monitoring shows tokens down ~80% since cap. Keeping watch.

Maya (CS): Thanks team. We'll finalize QBR numbers after the postmortem and customer call. :white_check_mark:
